title: ShortGPT: Layers in Large Language Models are More Redundant Than You Expect
source_finding: Ranks layers using input/output activation similarity; distinguishes static layer pruning from a separate generation-time scheme.
our_inference: Calibration-based block selection is a follow-up to the fixed [0,2,3] policy. No ShortGPT reproduction or performance transfer is claimed.

title: Git Re-Basin: Merging Models modulo Permutation Symmetries
source_finding: Uses function-preserving hidden-unit permutations to align independently trained models before merging their weights; reports empirical mode-connectivity findings and limitations.
our_inference: Neuron alignment may be worth testing for weight-curve construction. Adjacent-layer interpolation is a different problem; phase 6 does not establish misalignment as the cause of its quality gap.
